title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1801 Town and Country Drive in Norco, California, as the "Lance Corporal Kareem Nikoui Memorial Post Office Building".
official_summary: This bill designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1801 Town and Country Drive in Norco, California, as the Lance Corporal Kareem Nikoui Memorial Post Office Building.

summary.headline: Congress named a Norco, California Postal Service building after Lance Corporal Kareem Nikoui.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1801 Town and Country Drive in Norco, California, as the Lance Corporal Kareem Nikoui Memorial Post Office Building. It is a naming law only and does not change how the post office operates. The official summary does not describe any other changes.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on October 11, 2022.
